类 PlayerEggThrowEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerEvent
org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerEggThrowEvent
public class PlayerEggThrowEvent extends PlayerEvent
Called when a player throws an egg and it might hatch 当玩家投掷鸡蛋且鸡蛋可能孵化时调用

    • isHatching

      public boolean isHatching()
      Gets whether the egg is hatching or not. Will be what the server would've done without interaction. 获取鸡蛋是否会孵化。该值即服务器在没有干预时将会采取的行为。
      返回:
      boolean Whether the egg is going to hatch or not 鸡蛋是否会孵化

    • getNumHatches

      public byte getNumHatches()
      Get the number of mob hatches from the egg. By default the number will be the number the server would've done 获取该鸡蛋孵出的生物数量。默认情况下，该数值即服务器本来会产生的数量
      • 7/8 chance of being 0 7/8 的概率为 0
      • 31/256 ~= 1/8 chance to be 1 31/256 ≈ 1/8 的概率为 1
      • 1/256 chance to be 4 1/256 的概率为 4
      返回:
      The number of mobs going to be hatched by the egg 将被该鸡蛋孵出的生物数量

    • setNumHatches

      public void setNumHatches(byte numHatches)
      Change the number of mobs coming out of the hatched egg 更改从孵化鸡蛋中出来的生物数量

      The boolean hatching will override this number. Ie. If hatching = false, this number will not matter 布尔值 hatching 会覆盖此数值。也就是说，若 hatching = false，此数值将不起作用。

      参数:
      numHatches - The number of mobs coming out of the egg 从鸡蛋中出来的生物数量
